g.text: List fires and LIST-CASCADE of a VectorDB collection (LM-b)
OFFER-VDB(x): the element of a send
single mode: x is eligible for the query of W,
the pattern binds x, and the guard admits
list mode: x is in L(W, R + x), the pattern
binds that list, and the guard admits
store x with its embedding: x settles
a parked waiter W, in the canonical order,
of the list: one K_retire COMM each
yes: a peek takes no datum
x is spent: not persistent, and W does not peek?
W is persistent: a divergent pair?
x stops at the round cap
offer x to the next waiter
a second send is owed, or a record left?
stop: one settle job carries the owed
second sends and the resume of x
x stopped at the round cap?
no: x settled, or a divergent pair
one settle job carries the owed work
pop the last owe and OFFER-VDB it
a stop there owes it again and stops
waiter W, in the canonical order, whose list
L(W, R) is not empty, binds, and passes the guard
LIFT-AND-REOFFER: lift the first member v
with K_lift when v is not persistent,
owe v as a second send
the records of the collection: stores, retires and lifts
a capacity failure, a stop, or a re-issue
a fire, a settled element, or the end of the tail
